Weeknight lentil soup

This soup uses pantry ingredients and tolerates substitutions. Browning the vegetables first gives the broth enough depth without a long simmer.

Ingredients

  • One cup brown lentils
  • Two carrots, diced
  • One onion, diced
  • Four cups vegetable stock

Method

  1. Cook the onion and carrots until their edges begin to color.
  2. Add lentils and stock, then simmer until tender.
  3. Season with lemon, salt, and black pepper before serving.

Leftovers keep for three days. Add a small amount of water when reheating because the lentils continue to absorb broth.
